title: Tunisian Smoked Chicken Shawarma
description: A flavorful and aromatic sandwich filled with smoky chicken, topped with crunchy vegetables and served on a crusty flatbread.

ingredients.name: tunisian spice blend
ingredients.notes: available at most middle eastern markets

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together smoked paprika, tunisian spice blend, salt, and pepper.
Add the chicken breast to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast to the skillet and cook for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Transfer the chicken to a cutting board and let rest for 5 minutes before slicing into thin strips.
Warm the flatbread in the oven or in a dry skillet for a few minutes.
Assemble the shawarma by spreading a layer of tahini on the flatbread, followed by sliced chicken, red onion, tomato, cucumber, and lettuce.
Drizzle with lemon juice and serve immediately.
